_comment: AI-ready tile metadata for the Superpowers Medieval Fantasy pack (CC0, Pixel-boy / sparklinlabs). Verified by visual inspection of the sheet with per-cell index overlays, 2026-10-05. Background color varies PER TILE (white, maroon, light blue): do not assume one key color. Key by flood-filling from the tile edges through any bg_key_colors pixel. Multi-tile objects must be assembled from ALL listed cells; placing a single cell of one produces a broken sprite (this was the v1 POC bug).
bg_key_note: white / maroon / light-blue. Flood-fill from edges through any of these; interior detail pixels (flames, highlights) are enclosed and survive.

custom_tiles.dirt_path: no dirt tile exists in this sheet (29 is a solid terracotta block, not a path). Hand-drawn in tools/build_level_poc.py from grass hues.

big_tree.note: v1 used 196 alone: wrong, it is the top-right quarter

campfire.note: v1 used 156 as 'campfire': 156 is a gray rock. This is the real campfire.

pine_tree.note: canopy reads as one 2-wide pine; twin trunks are the pack's chunky style

rock.note: gray rock; v1 mislabeled this as the campfire

round_tree.note: v1 used 92 alone as 'round tree' and 112 alone as 'pine tree': both wrong, they are quarters of this tree

shack.note: small house front with door; light-blue key

tent_orange.note: v1 used 86 as 'tent': 86 is a 1x1 shack/house front, not a tent. This is the real tent.

unverified_skipped.dome_b: 69,89 vs 129 have inconsistent bg colors; relationship unconfirmed, skipped
unverified_skipped.yurt: cells 197,198/217,218 with 219 ambiguous: dome is 2 wide, wall may be 3 wide; skipped rather than mis-mapped
